left.title: Mueller subpoenas Trump campaign for Russia documents
left.body: Special counsel Robert Mueller's team has issued a subpoena to the Trump campaign asking multiple campaign officials to produce Russia-related documents, according to a source with first-hand knowledge of the matter.
left.roundup: Special Counsel Robert Mueller has subpoenaed the Trump campaign for the first time, requesting documents related to Russia from more than a dozen top officials.

center.title: Special Counsel Mueller Issued Subpoena for Russia-Related Documents From Trump Campaign Officials
center.body: Special counsel Robert Mueller’s team in mid-October issued a subpoena to President Donald Trump’s campaign requesting Russia-related documents from more than a dozen top officials, according to a person familiar with the matter.
center.roundup: Special Counsel Robert Mueller has subpoenaed the Trump campaign for the first time, requesting documents related to Russia from more than a dozen top officials.

right.title: Report: Mueller issued subpoenas for a dozen Trump campaign officials
right.body: According to the Wall Street Journal, Special Counsel Robert Mueller’s investigation into Russian collusion and election tampering included issuing subpoenas for over a dozen Trump campaign officials.
right.roundup: Special Counsel Robert Mueller has subpoenaed the Trump campaign for the first time, requesting documents related to Russia from more than a dozen top officials.
